# SoHo Wealth

> SoHo Wealth is a Hyderabad-based wealth-planning, portfolio-review and investment-distribution firm serving HNIs, founders, families and NRIs across India.

SoHo Wealth is an AMFI mutual fund and Specialized Investment Fund distributor (ARN 306593) and an APMI Portfolio Management Services distributor (APRN01233). SoHo Wealth is not a SEBI Registered Investment Adviser. Distribution compensation may be received from product manufacturers. Product eligibility, risk, liquidity, fees, tax treatment and official documents should be reviewed before investing. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
